use_case_name: Add Files to an Existing Archive

claims.content: To add files or folders to an existing archive using the Create Archive Interface.

goal.raw_text: To add files or folders to an existing archive using the Create Archive Interface.

claims.content: User
The user is logged into the computer system and has access to the PeaZip application.
An existing archive file must be present on the local disk or accessible drive (e.g., C:, D:, E:) that can be selected for modification.
The user must have navigated to or opened the 'Create Archive Interface' where archiving options and target files are managed.
The user selects the 'Add' button or menu option from the File Manager Interface to initiate the process of adding files to an existing archive.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects the 'Add' button or menu option from the File Manager Interface to initiate the process of adding files to an existing archive.

claims.content: The user selects the 'Add' button from the File Manager Interface toolbar.
The system opens the 'Create .zip, new archive' interface (Create Archive Interface).
The user specifies the output file path and name in the 'Output' field of the Create Archive Interface.
The user configures the desired 'Format options', such as selecting the archive format (e.g., ZIP) and volume settings.
The user reviews the list of files and folders to be added in the 'Archiving' section of the interface.
The user clicks the 'Ok' button to confirm the settings and initiate the archiving process.
The system displays a progress window (PeaLauncher) showing the status of the job, including input/output sizes and time elapsed.
Upon successful completion, the system displays a 'Job successfully completed' message in the progress window.
The user may choose to encrypt the archive by setting a password and/or keyfile before finalizing the operation.
The user can split the selected objects' data content into more than one archive volume, defining the size of each volume manually.
The user may opt to append a timestamp to the created archive's name for archiving and backup purposes.
If a homonym file or archive already exists in the selected storage space, the user must define what action should be taken (e.g., overwrite, rename).

If the user attempts to add files but a homonym file or archive already exists in the selected storage space, the system requires the user to define an action (e.g., overwrite, rename) before proceeding.

If the user selects encryption options (password/keyfile) but fails to set them correctly or encounters an error during the locking process, the system may prevent the archive from being created until the issue is resolved.

If the PeaLauncher backend binary encounters an error during the job execution (e.g., insufficient disk space, permission denied), it will remain open displaying the error message instead of closing automatically upon completion.
The selected files and folders have been successfully added to the specified archive file.
The system displays a 'Job successfully completed' message in the PeaLauncher progress window.
The progress window shows the final input size, output size (with compression percentage), and total time elapsed for the operation.
If encryption was configured, the archive is locked with the specified password and/or keyfile.
